glosses: Ajouter la syntaxe wiki au sein d’un article, c’est-à-dire les mots en gras encadrés de trois apostrophes, les mots en italiques de deux, les liens internes de deux crochets, etc.
Remplacer la syntaxe HTML par la syntaxe wiki, par exemple dans un tableau.

examples.text: Il est possible de « wikifier » soit un site web soit un texte de votre choix.

glosses: To adapt to the standards and facilities of an existing wiki, such as by marking up with wikitext.

examples.text: As a starting point, I've wikified an article I wrote a while ago.
I added a justification, and tried to "wikify" the entry, which involved adding references and reformatting the text.

We don't yet know how blogs will evolve, and it is almost certain that what we will be using in ten years will be very different from what we might be using now––but who will be taking the lead in making sure that these are organized and preserved and described in such a way that we can guide someone to the relevant blog posting or wikified document as readily as we now direct them to a particular journal article?

glosses: To make into a wiki, or to use a wiki approach for.

examples.text: The Los Angeles Times proved this last week, with its high-minded but ultimately hilarious attempt to 'wikify ' its editorial column.
Although he's adamant that NCBI is not going to "wikify" GenBank, Lipman says he's eager to work with mycologists to come up with a solution, possibly through RefSeq.

glosses: To use or participate in a wiki.

examples.text: "They can blog and podcast and 'wikify ' and do all sorts of things we could not even imagine until very recently."

glosses: Adaptar un contenido a los estándares y normas de redacción de una wiki.
неол. жарг. викип. выполнить или выполнять викификацию; в широком значении — привести (приводить) текст в соответствие правилам вики-разметки, в узком — расставить (расставлять) внутренние ссылки

examples.text: Понятие викификации в Википедии и Викисловаре различаются, если в первом «викифицировать» означает проставить внутренние ссылки на понятия, то в Викисловаре — на леммы слов.
